descriptions.preferred: The name means "ground spider. " This delightful semidwarf cultivar has small leaves of the Palmatum Group. When the new growth first unfolds, the leaves are a rust red, soon changing to bright green. This color holds well all summer and does not burn in full sun. Fall color is bright gold, with crimson edging blending into the gold tones. The interesting leaves are have five or seven lobes separated to about 1 cm from the leaf base. The leaves are 2-4 cm long and wide on old wood, to 5 cm long and wide on vigorous new growth. On old plants the twigs are closely spaced. rhs.description: A small, deciduous tree about 4m at maturity with 5 to 7-lobed leaves to 4cm long, tapering to a sharp point and radiating outwards, with slightly turned margins. Leaves are rust-red when emerging in spring, then bright green and finally bright gold with crimson edging in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型落叶乔木，成熟时高约 4 米。 叶片长达 4 厘米，具 5-7 裂，裂片渐尖，向外放射展开，叶缘略微翻卷。 春季新叶呈锈红色，随后转为鲜绿色，秋季则为明亮金黄色并带深红色镶边。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 其名称意为“地蜘蛛”。 这是一个迷人的半矮生品种，具 Palmatum Group 的小型叶片。 新梢初展时叶色为锈红，随后很快转为鲜绿色。 该叶色整个夏季保持良好，在全日照下也不易焦叶。 秋色为明亮的金黄色，边缘带深红色，并与金色调自然交融。 其有趣的叶片具五裂或七裂，自叶基以上约 1 厘米处分开。 老枝上的叶片长宽为 2-4 厘米，生长旺盛的新梢上则可达 5 厘米。 老株枝条节间短、排列紧密。 裂片呈狭长卵形，渐尖成锐尖，向外辐射展开。 该品种在 Corvallis 一带颇受重视。 其初期生长速度略快于 'Shishigashira'，但最终不会长得那么高；虽枝条坚实，但不像后者那样短粗。 日本一份资料称“如今在日本已见不到这个品种”。 显然它属于二战期间园艺中断时失传的品种之一，但现已重新引入。
